name: track_io_timing
description: Enables collection of timing statistics for database I/O operations.
symptoms: Missing I/O latency metrics in pg_stat_database
Inability to analyze I/O timing via EXPLAIN (BUFFERS)
No I/O timing data available in pg_stat_statements
Incomplete performance diagnostics for storage-bound workloads
tuning_tips: Enable only when diagnosing I/O performance issues, as it incurs measurable OS time-query overhead; disable after analysis to reduce CPU usage.
